mechanism.claim: An actual BTCUSDT funding settlement far from its own causal rolling median identifies unusually one-sided leverage crowding. In elevated realized variation, fade the funding residual for the next inventory cycle.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of current funding rate minus its strictly-prior 90-settlement median
mechanism.why_distinct: HVEFR uses the level residual at every actual settlement, not the failed fixed 00-to-08 acceleration contract, price/funding sign confirmation, cross-alt funding, OI, options volatility, or a prior diagnostic control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed prior-24h BTC variation causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: only extreme residual settlements survive two causal ranks and an eight-hour global reservation

features.funding_median: median of at most 90 strictly previous actual settlements, minimum 60; current excluded
features.funding_residual: current funding_rate minus causal median, strict nonzero
features.residual_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute residual over at most 270 valid residuals, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m close-to-close BTC log returns over [settlement-24h,settlement))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank at actual settlement opportunities over at most 270 valid states, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: actual funding_time after funding rate and prior BTC path are available
clock.reservation: chronological half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: all exact settlements during held interval included only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent causal funding-level residual crowding mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no history, rank, residual, side, variation, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
